 Recap: Spurs extend win streak to 11, Heat duo dominate and more from Friday's Emirates NBA Cup night
 The Heat and Rockets lead a handful of teams to get their 1st Group Play victory, while the Spurs continue their torrid stretch.
 Jerry Jiang, for NBA.com
 November 14, 2026 8:26 AM The Spurs earn a wire-to-wire victory over the Warriors — their 11th consecutive win.
 The Indiana Pacers got their first win in Emirates NBA Cup Group Play as they beat the defending Emirates NBA Cup champions New York Knicks 106-104 . The San Antonio Spurs continued to click on all cylinders with another win, stretching their win streak to 11 as they earned a wire-to-wire win vs. the Golden State Warriors.  
 What we know about Emirates NBA Cup Group Play, Nov. 13
 Every starter from the Indiana Pacers scored in double figures as they knocked off the Knicks.  
 Franz Wagner continued his hot streak as he recorded his fourth consecutive game with 30+ points. Desmond Bane contributed 21 points in the win.  
 Giannis Antetokounmpo and Bam Adebayo tally 37 points each as the Heat earned their first Emirates NBA Cup win.  
 The Bulls get 33 points from Norman Powell along with double-figure scoring from 6 others as they outlasted the Hawks in overtime.  
 The Grizzlies get balanced scoring as 10 players scored double figures in the win over the Pelicans.  
 Despite the loss, Darryn Peterson became the first Jazz rookie since Donovan Mitchell (3x in 2017-18) to record at least five consecutive games with 20+ points. He also became the first teenager (19 years, 300d) in Jazz franchise history to accomplish the feat.  
 Alperen Sengun dropped 43 points, 12 rebounds and 5 assists on 70% shooting as the Rockets beat the Jazz.  
 Spurs secured their 11th straight win as they defeated the Warriors 123-85 behind 32 points from Stephon Castle.  
 The Trail Blazers defeated the Kings 120-107 as Deni Avdija filled the stat sheet with 34 points, 6 rebounds and 4 assists. 
 Darius Garland and the LA Clippers withstood SGA’s 40-point night and got their first win in Emirates NBA Cup Group Play.
01:20 AM / NOV. 14 
 Friday’s Results
 Pacers 106, Knicks 104 
 Magic 107, Bucks 99   
 Heat 133, Cavaliers 121 
 Bulls 125, Hawks 117 
 Grizzlies 142, Pelicans 111 
 Rockets 125, Jazz 118 
 Spurs 123, Warriors 85 
 Trail Blazers 120, Kings 107 
 Clippers 113, Thunder 112 
 12:56 AM / NOV. 14 
 Clippers Prevail Late Thanks To Garland’s Clutch Bucket
 Clippers 113, Thunder 112. Final .  
 It started with a Darius Garland 3-pointer, which Shai Gilgeous-Alexander answered with a 3-pointer of his own.  
 Then, after a few Thunder free throws, Brook Lopez had back-to-back tough buckets.  
 The Clippers got clutch stops, and Garland answered with a tough and-one.  
 DARIUS GARLAND GO-AHEAD AND-1 TO SEAL THE WEST GROUP B WIN FOR THE CLIPPERS 🚨
 HE FINISHED WITH 24 POINTS! pic.twitter.com/Q4Qr1jCFLy 
 — NBA (@NBA) November 14, 2026 
 The Thunder had one more chance to win the game, but SGA’s attempt was just a little off.  
 The Thunder trailed by more than 16 points. It was their third game in four nights and it showed in Friday’s loss.  
 SGA dropped 40 points and Jared McCain had a career-high 7 3-pointers, but it wasn’t enough as Garland’s 24 points and Lopez’ 26 points kept the Clippers in front.  
 12:48 AM / NOV. 14  
 Things Are Heating Up In LA
 Thunder 105, Clippers 103. 3:49, 4Q.   
 Alex Caruso drills the 3-pointer as the Thunder keep their two-point lead.  
 Can the Thunder close out the game and earn a tough win in Emirates NBA Cup Group Play?  
12:35 AM / NOV. 14 
 Trail Blazers Beat Kings
 Trail Blazers 120, Kings 107 
 The Portland Trail Blazers continue to roll in the early part of the season as they get their first win in Emirates NBA Cup Group Play.  
 Deni Avdija dropped 34 points, 6 rebounds and 4 assists, while Damian Lillard got hot with 6 3-pointers and 29 points. Donovan Clingan tallied a double-double with 13 points and 11 rebounds, and the Trail Blazers shot 40.5% from 3-point range.  
12:23 AM / NOV. 14 
 McCain Beats The Buzzer
 Thunder 84, Clippers 82. End 3Q .  
 Jared McCain, who spent his high school years in Southern California, answers the bell on the road as the Oklahoma City Thunder end the third quarter with an 84-82 lead over the LA Clippers.  
 McCain is feeling it with 20 points and is shooting 6-for-9 from the 3-point range. 15 of his 20 points came in the third quarter. He later drilled another 3-pointer for a new career-high.  
 JARED MCCAIN HAS A CAREER-HIGH 7 THREES 🔥
 HE'S UP TO 23 PTS AS OKC LEADS IN Q4! pic.twitter.com/tmNY9HzSjL 
 — NBA (@NBA) November 14, 2026 
 Shai Gilgeous-Alexander leads the Thunder with 32 points and Isaiah Hartenstein adds a 13-point, 14-rebound double-double as the Thunder claw their way back from a 15-point deficit. into the game.  
12:02 AM / NOV. 14 
 A Dominant Win For The Spurs
 Warriors 85, Spurs 123. Final .  
 The Spurs won wire-to-wire. Their biggest lead was 43 points.  
 Victor Wembanyama tallied 12 points, 12 rebounds and 6 assists in 20 minutes of play and Keldon Johnson added 18 points. Stephon Castle drilled 5 3-pointers. Check out his night here.  
 STEPHON CASTLE DROPS 32.
SPURS WIN 11th STRAIGHT.
 32 PTS
5 REB
6 AST
5 3PM
 San Antonio improves to 2-0 in West Group C! pic.twitter.com/7UTF5ecx0s 
 — NBA (@NBA) November 14, 2026 
11:48 PM / NOV. 13 
 Jordan McLaughlin Turns Back The Clock
 Warriors 77, Spurs 113. 5:31, 4Q .  
 The nine-year NBA veteran gets crafty with the scoop layup.  
 It’s been all Spurs since the tip.  
11:28 PM / NOV. 13 
 Dame Dolla Beats The Buzzer
 Kings 53, Trail Blazers 64. End 1H .  
 There’s no such thing as a limit range for Damian Lillard.  
 He creates space in transition and nails the 26-footer as the Trail Blazers go to halftime with the lead. Lillard has 10 points and 3 3-pointers already.  
 DAME BEATS THE Q2 BUZZER FROM DEEP 🎯
 Portland leads in West Group C action! pic.twitter.com/alPpQZbOj5 
 — NBA (@NBA) November 14, 2026 
11:23 PM / NOV. 13 
 What A Night For Alperen Sengun
 Jazz 118, Rockets 125. Final .  
 With 43 points, 12 rebounds and 5 assists, Alperen Sengun became the third player in Houston Rockets franchise history to record 40+ PTS, 10+ REB and 5+ AST on 70%+ field goal shooting percentage since 1956-57, the first season field goal percentage was fully recorded, joining Hakeem Olajuwon (1994) and Yao Ming (2004).  
 ALPEREN SENGUN'S GOT 41 POINTS 🔥
 41 PTS
11 REB
5 AST
 ROCKETS LEAD IN Q4. pic.twitter.com/KZL8w2TZqY 
 — NBA (@NBA) November 14, 2026 
 Kevin Durant also helped out with 22 points and 6 assists in the win. The Rockets go 10-3 on the season and rise to No. 3 in the Western Conference.  
 Despite the loss, Darryn Peterson had his fifth straight game with 20+ points, finishing with a career-high 28 points.  
11:15 PM / NOV. 13 
 Castle’s On Fire!
 Warriors 43, Spurs 76. 7:25, 3Q .  
 The Spurs turn defense into offense as Wembanyama gets the stop and finds Castle, who throws it down in transition.  
 Castle’s up to 25 points, a new season high.
 WEMBY LOB TO CASTLE (28 PTS) FOR THE REVERSE SLAM 💥
 THE SPURS ARE ON FIRE AS THEY PUSH FOR THEIR 11th STRAIGHT WIN! pic.twitter.com/r9UXLCXRng 
 — NBA (@NBA) November 14, 2026 
11:04 PM / NOV. 13 
 Grizzlies Make Franchise History
 Pelicans 111, Grizzlies 142. Final.   
 Friday night marks the first time in Grizzlies franchise history that the team had 10 players score 10+ points each. This is the first time that a team has done this since April 11, 2025, when Miami had 10 players score 10+ points each against New Orleans.  
 THE GRIZZLIES HAD A FRANCHISE-RECORD 10 PLAYERS IN DOUBLE FIGURES 🤯
 Jerami Grant (22 PTS) and Ty Jerome (17 PTS) led the way as Memphis picked up the West Group B win! pic.twitter.com/abrg3dP4Am 
 — NBA (@NBA) November 14, 2026 
 The Grizzlies were led by Jerami Grant, who poured in 22 points in the win. Cameron Boozer had a 12-point, 10-rebound double-double.  
10:57 PM / NOV. 13 
 Spurs In Cruise Control
 Warriors 33, Spurs 63. Half .  
 It’s been all Spurs as they head into halftime with a 30-point lead.  
 They’ve cooled off a bit since their blistering start, but continue to shoot 42.1% from 3-point range and 50% from the field. Castle has 18 points and 4 3-pointers.
 10:55 PM / NOV. 13 
 Bulls Outlast Hawks’ Furious Late Rally
 Hawks 117, Bulls 125. Final .  
 It was a back-and-forth game that featured three lead changes and six ties.  
 Norman Powell led the way for the Bulls with 33 points, while Josh Giddey did it all with 15 points, 10 rebounds and 14 assists.  
 NORMAN POWELL AND MATAS BUZELIS IN THE CLUTCH TO SEAL THE EAST GROUP C WIN FOR CHICAGO IN OT 🔥
 Powell finished with a game-high 33 PTS! pic.twitter.com/UnWydQ8Wtl 
 — NBA (@NBA) November 14, 2026 
 Despite the loss, Jalen Johnson tallied his 16th career triple-double with 27 points, 11 rebounds and 10 assists.
 10:50 PM / NOV. 13 
 A Trio Of Heat Players Make History
 Heat 133, Cavs 121. Final .  
 There have been questions about the fit between Giannis Antetokounmpo and Bam Adebayo when Antetokounmpo got traded to the Heat this past offseason.  
 This game was very positive, as Antetokounmpo and Adebayo both score 37 points. They join LeBron James and Dwyane Wade as the only duos in Heat franchise history to each record 35+ points in the same game. James and Wade accomplished this twice.  
 Adebayo also grabbed 14 rebounds to go along with his 37 points, which were season highs for him.
 GIANNIS AND BAM JOINED LEBRON AND WADE IN MIAMI'S EAST GROUP B WIN 🤯
 Giannis: 37 PTS, 9 REB
Bam: 37 PTS, 14 REB
 2nd duo in @MiamiHEAT franchise history (joining LeBron James & Dwyane Wade in 2012 and 2013) to score 35+ PTS in the same game! pic.twitter.com/JMc1ZTKUmc 
 — NBA (@NBA) November 14, 2026 
 Additionally, Davion Mitchell had himself a night with 22 points, 17 assist and 5 rebounds. It’s the most assists by a Heat player in a game since Goran Dragić in 2016.  
 Mitchell became the third player in Heat franchise history to record 20+ PTS, 15+ AST and 1 or fewer turnovers in a single game. He joins Wade and Dragić.  
10:30 PM / NOV. 13 
 Why Run Plays When You Have Wemby?
 Warriors 22, Spurs 45. 6:47, 2Q .  
 The Warriors found some offensive life with an 8-0 run.  
 Then, Castle found Wembanyama for the slam, ending that stretch for the Warriors.  
 Wembanyama is averaging 5.2 dunks per game. There’s no need to run plays when you have Wembanyama on the floor.  
10:17 PM / NOV. 13 
 The Largest Spurs’ Run In The Play-By-Play Era
 Warriors 14, Spurs 38. End 1Q.   
 The Spurs’ 18-0 run is their largest run to open a game in the play-by-play era.  
 Check out the entire uncut run here.  
 18-0 SPURS RUN TO START THE GAME, UNCUT 💨
 IT'S THEIR LARGEST RUN TO OPEN A GAME IN THE PLAY-BY-PLAY ERA! pic.twitter.com/0nt6piSDlg 
 — NBA (@NBA) November 14, 2026 
10:03 PM / NOV. 13 
 Warriors Seeking Offense As Spurs Roll
 Warriors 8, Spurs 26. 3:25, 1Q .  
 The Warriors are starting to find some offense as LJ Cryer has 6 points and Gui Santos broke the scoring seal.  
 Meanwhile, Castle has 13 early points and has made all 3 of his 3-pointers. 
 Oh, and Victor Wembanyama is doing Victor Wembanyama things too.
 WEMBY REVERSE SLAM TO CAP OFF AN 18-0 RUN FOR THE SPURS 😲
 SAN ANTONIO IS SIZZLING ON PRIME! pic.twitter.com/IGPj5J8SDM 
 — NBA (@NBA) November 14, 2026 
9:49 PM / NOV. 13 
 12-0 Start For The Spurs
 Warriors 0, Spurs 12. 9:33, 1Q.   
 Victor Wembanyama is doing it all to start the game with 3 assists. 
 The Spurs have shot 5-for-6 from the field. Stephon Castle has 6 points early. The Spurs have a 12-0 lead.  
9:45 PM / NOV. 13 
 Pacers Escape With Cup Win
 Knicks 104, Pacers 106. Final .  
 After Siakam missed two free throws that would’ve put the game away, the Knicks rushed back and put themselves in a position to come back after Mikal Bridges cut the Pacers’ lead to 2.  
 The Knicks get a critical stop after forcing the Pacers to a turnover.  
 But with a chance to send the game to overtime, Towns missed the go-ahead jumper and the Pacers survived. 
 The Pacers are 1-1 in Group Play and the Emirates NBA Cup defending champions go 0-2.  
 PACERS HOLD ON FOR THE EAST GROUP B WIN IN A THRILLER! pic.twitter.com/y3SOxZAl7E 
 — NBA (@NBA) November 14, 2026 
9:32 PM / NOV. 13  
 Yaxel’s Rise Gives The Warriors New Life
 Warriors vs. Spurs. Pregame .  
 Heading into this season, the Golden State Warriors were without Jimmy Butler, Moses Moody and Kristaps Porziņġis, who later announced he was stepping away from basketball.  
 After losing their first three games, things were looking bleak. Then, the Warriors rattled off eight straight wins. 
 Stephen Curry, who will miss the next two weeks due to his oblique injury, was the main catalyst in the surge. 
 But another surprise came along: rookie Yaxel Lendeborg.   
 Some rookies look to start their careers in stride, but for Lendeborg, he has high expectations.  
 “I’m trying to be an All-Star this year,” Lendeborg told Amazon Prime’s Taylor Rooks. “I want to be the young guy that changes the whole persona of the team.”  
 It’s safe to say that through his early career, Lendeborg has done that by injecting new life into the Warriors. He’s averaging 21.7 ppg, 7.4 rpg and 3.7 apg through 12 games.  
 The Warriors are 1-1 without Curry this season. In a 124-112 win over the LA Clippers, a game that Curry missed, Lendeborg recorded his career-high 37 points. That was the highest-scoring performance by a Warriors rookie since Curry’s 42 points in 2010.  
 Now, Lendeborg and the Warriors look to snap the Spurs’ 10-game win streak after having their own 8-game win streak snapped the game before.  
 "I want to be the young guy that changes the whole persona of the team."
 Yaxel Lendeborg wants to make a big impact in his first season with the Warriors 🌉
 🍿 GSW/SAS
📺 9:30pm/et, Prime https://t.co/tV9bvmxv1m 
 — NBA (@NBA) November 14, 2026 
9:23 PM / NOV. 13  
 Pacers Barrage
 Knicks 89, Pacers 99. 7:42, 4Q .  
 Every time the Knicks find some rhythm, the Pacers fight back with a run of their own.  
 Five Pacers starters are up to double-digit scoring, led by Siakam’s 17 points. Ivica Zubac has a double-double with 12 points and 12 rebounds.  
 They’re in the midst of a 12-2 run.  
 9:16 PM / NOV. 13 
 Franz Heat Check
 Bucks 84, Magic 94. 4:29, 4Q .  
 Franz Wagner recorded his fourth consecutive game with 30+ PTS, marking the longest such streak of his career. He now has 33 points and counting as the Magic are in cruise control.  
 He filled up the stat sheet with 9 rebounds and 11 assists.
 9:13 PM / NOV. 13 
 Giannis Eurosteps His Way To A Major Dunk
 Cavaliers 57, Heat 54. End 1H .  
 What do you do when you see Giannis Antetokounmpo flying at full speed with bad intentions at the rim?  
 You would probably concede the dunk, as there’s no defense for that. Well, the Cavaliers did just that, as there was definitely no defense for this play.  
 Giannis is up to 17 points and 7 rebounds, but the Heat trail heading into the second half.  
 GIANNIS EUROS INTO A POSTER SLAM 😲 pic.twitter.com/q54CDeBW0J 
 — NBA (@NBA) November 14, 2026 
8:58 PM / NOV. 13 
 The Brunson Burner Is Alive
 Knicks 84, Pacers 85. End 3Q .  
 The Knicks continue to show their fight as they are on a 13-2 run over the last 2 minutes. 
 Brunson creates space with his nifty footwork and drills the bucket for 27 points on the night. He also has nine assists.  
 The Knicks end the 3Q with a 15-4 run. They trim Indiana’s lead to 1.  
 8:57 PM / NOV. 13  
 Rise Up, Jerami Grant!
 Grizzlies 48, Pelicans 45. 5:31, 2Q .  
 Ty Jerome finds a rolling Jerami Grant, who throws it down with authority.  
 Grant has 7 points as the Grizzlies and Pelicans battle in West Group B.  
 JERAMI GRANT ONE-HAND SLAM 💥 pic.twitter.com/Ru94gafoO8 
 — NBA (@NBA) November 14, 2026 
 8:54 PM / NOV. 13 
 Count It For 4 For Desmond Bane
 Bucks 75, Magic 87. 9:49, 4Q .  
 Desmond Bane is dangerous in transition with his shooting, as demonstrated here.  
 Bane finds the range on the 3-pointer and gets the foul as well. Bane notches 21 points, and he joins Wagner (27) as the Magic players who have scored 20+ points.  
 The Magic are leading comfortably in the third.  
 DESMOND BANE 4-POINT PLAY 🔥
 He's up to 21 PTS (13 in Q3)! pic.twitter.com/PELThygdv1 
 — NBA (@NBA) November 14, 2026 
 8:52 PM / NOV. 13 
 Spida Gets Tricky With This Dime
 Cavaliers 41, Heat 43. 6:16, 2Q .  
 Although he initially gets on the ground after losing the ball, Donovan “Spida” Mitchell somehow gets the ball over to Tyrese Proctor, who nails the 3-pointer.  
 After this bucket, Proctor has 12 points as the Cavaliers try to come back in the game. 
 SPIDA FINDS PROCTOR FROM THE GROUND 🎯
 Tyrese Proctor has 12 PTS (3 3PM) in Q1! pic.twitter.com/oNbe4acMHA 
 — NBA (@NBA) November 14, 2026 
8:43 PM / NOV. 13 
 History For Buddy Hield
 Hawks 31, Bulls 46. 9:05, 2Q. 
 Buddy Hield has always been a great 3-point shooter throughout his career. Whether it’s with the Sacramento Kings, the Indiana Pacers, the Golden State Warriors or now with the Chicago Bulls, Hield will give you 3’s when you need them.  
 His best season shooting the 3-pointer was in the 2017-18 season with the Sacramento Kings, where he shot 43.1% from distance.  
 On Friday, he made history as Hield passed Kyle Lowry for 14th on the All-Time 3-point made list. Next up is Jamal Crawford at No. 13. 
8:42 / NOV. 13 
 Knicks Find Their Rhythm
 Knicks 60, Pacers 65. 8:45, 3Q.   
 Whenever a coach calls a timeout when the game, half or quarter just started, it’s usually not a good sign. 
 After Oubre nailed a 3-pointer, Mike Brown didn’t like what he saw and immediately called a timeout. Since then, the Knicks have woken up and rallied off 8 straight points, cutting the Pacers’ lead to 5.  
 KAT also made history as he recorded his 12th consecutive double-double to start the season, surpassing Willis Reed (11) for the second-longest streak in Knicks franchise history. He now trails Walt Bellamy (13).  
8:16 PM / NOV. 13 
 Pacers Playing At Their Pace
 Knicks 49, Pacers 58. End 1H.   
 It’s been a back-and-forth battle, but the Pacers have taken control heading into halftime with a nine-point lead.  
 Pascal Siakam is leading the way with 13 points and the Pacers are utilizing all of their bench with 11 players suiting up already. They’re shooting 41.6% from the field and 40% from the 3-point range.  
 The Knicks are led by their star-studded duo Karl-Anthony Towns and Jalen Brunson, who have 14 and 13 points so far, respectively. Towns is one rebound shy of notching his 12th straight double-double.  
 Across 11 regular season games since joining the Knicks, Brunson is averaging 30 ppg while shooting 49.4% from the field when facing the Pacers. With the Knicks surging as of late, they’ll need Brunson and KAT to heat up in the second half to continue their strong play. 
 As for the Pacers, they’ve found success going to Siakam’s efficient play. Who else will step up to get the Pacers back on track?
7:52 PM / NOV. 13 
 Franz Continues Hot Start   
 Magic 34, Bucks 27. 5:34, 2Q .  
 Franz Wagner dropped 38 points in a 123-108 win over the Utah Jazz on Wednesday, tying a career high. 
 Wagner is continuing his blistering shooting. He’s up to 14 points and has already drilled 2 3-pointers while shooting 5-for-7 from the field.  
7:42 PM / NOV. 13 
 No Love Lost Between These Two Teams
 Knicks 38, Pacers 35. 7:26, 2Q .  
 The Knicks and Pacers have a storied history. As Eastern Conference rivals, the Knicks lead the overall series 115-97, but the Pacers lead 30-24 in playoff games and overall series wins (6-3).  
 Since 1993, these two teams have met in the playoffs nine times.  
 In their most recent playoff matchup in the 2025 Playoffs, Tyrese Haliburton and the Pacers came back from a 17-point deficit in Game 1, with an homage to Reggie Miller’s infamous celebration back in their 1995 series.  
 Right now, Karl-Anthony Towns is leading the Knicks as he’s up to 14 points, 12 of which came from the first quarter.
 KAT SCORED 12 PTS IN Q1 👏
 Knicks lead the Pacers on Prime! pic.twitter.com/QfhypIRVwX 
 — NBA (@NBA) November 14, 2026 
7:31 PM / NOV. 13 
 Jay Huff, The Rare 3-D Center
 Knicks 23, Pacers 24. 1:41 
 When the Pacers inserted Jay Huff, he inserted some energy to the game.  
 He scored 8 points in 4 minutes of action, with 2 3’s. Stan Van Gundy called him a “3-and-D center,” which is fascinating since that term is usually reserved for wings.  
 The Pacers are shooting 50% from the field as the pace (no pun intended) has picked up. 
7:20 PM / NOV. 13 
 Knicks Are Starting To Groove Early
 Knicks 16, Pacers 9. 7:39, 1Q   
 The Knicks are starting to look like their championship selves, zipping the ball with crisp passes and early transition buckets.  
 Through the first 11 games, the Knicks have been one of the slowest teams in the NBA in terms of pace, which was the direct opposite of the formula that worked for their championship run.  
 However, the Knicks are rolling early, with slick passes from Jalen Brunson and Josh Hart leading to easy buckets. The Knicks have made their last seven shots and their second 7-0 run of the game.  
 The Knicks have won six of their last eight games. Can they continue this good stretch?  
5:00 PM / NOV. 13
